title: The owner's AI Assistant and its workout plan writer are listed as not known to be live, but the Assistant runs live
what: The feature list marks the AI Assistant and the AI workout plan writer as 'unknown', waiting on secret keys. The admin app's What's new told owners on 13 Nov that the Assistant is live, and the test gym's AI credit record shows Assistant tasks saved on 14 Nov, which needs the AI key to be set. Every gym server part they call is present. So the Assistant works for real gyms while the map says nobody knows.
expected: A feature that has been announced and used live is listed as live, so the map can be trusted.
how_often: every time someone reads the feature list
fix_line: Mark the AI Assistant live and the plan writer live once one saved plan is seen

title: Members updating from Google Play are shown the notes of a newer version than Play gives them
what: The update screen's What's new lines come from our server, which always serves the newest release made on GitHub. On 26 Nov it answered version 0.80.0, while Google Play's public version is still 0.79.0. A Play phone takes those lines whenever they are for any version newer than its own, so a member on 0.78.0 offered 0.79.0 is told about 0.80.0's change (phone number sign-in keeping workouts safe) and does not get it after updating. This happens after every release until Play catches up, which can take days.
expected: A member sees the notes of the version Play will really install, or no notes when they are not known.
how_often: after every release until Play production catches up
fix_line: Only show notes for the version Play offers, or serve the notes of the version in Play production
